narr: A sea breeze boundary became the focus for afternoon thunderstorms. As storms began to develop, weak steering winds prevented them from moving very much. This resulted in heavy rain over an extended period which led to flash flooding in the New Orleans area.
ev: A member of the public reported numerous roads flooded near Elmwood.
Numerous roads in the Lower Garden District were flooded.
Multiple roads in Bridge City were impassible due to high water.
lsr: WATER FLOODING ACROSS ROADS AND INTO YARDS.
